parameters.name: dry_multiplier
parameters.description: DRY repetition penalty multiplier; 0 disables DRY sampling.

parameters.name: dry_base
parameters.description: Base of the exponential penalty growth for repeated sequences.

parameters.name: dry_allowed_length
parameters.description: Number of tokens that may repeat before the penalty applies.

parameters.name: dry_penalty_last_n
parameters.description: Window of recent tokens considered by the DRY penalty.

parameters.name: dry_sequence_breakers
parameters.description: Comma-separated sequences that reset repetition tracking; empty = none.

parameters.name: max_tokens
parameters.description: Maximum tokens the model may generate for one page.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Stream tokens as they arrive; false gives the parser one complete response.
